trimmedBy: node trim-ats-b-captures.mjs (@rgrove/parse-xml with offsets, whole <position> elements kept by their source slice, e-mail addresses replaced, envelope text before the first and after the last position kept as received); never a byte cut. 61 positions captured, 5 kept
notes: Westwing (language=en): 61 positions captured (674,732 bytes), 5 kept whole: a plain permanent full-time position (2630474), a fixed_term one (2703051), a freelance one with schedule full-or-part-time (2435528), a working_student part-time one (1968758) and one with NO <keywords> element (2702093; 60 of the 61 have one). OWNERSHIP VERIFIED, EVIDENCE: PAYLOAD_FIELD (subcompany "Westwing Group SE" on every kept position). No recruiter name or address is in the feed; an address in a description would have been replaced. ENDPOINT: https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language={code} (developer.personio.de: language is one of de, en, fr, es, nl, it, pt "depending on the languages available for the Career Site"; the feed must be switched on per company in Settings > Recruiting > Career page > Activations, support.personio.de). HOSTS: the .de and .com hosts served byte-identical documents for both tenants tried (sha256 equal), so they are aliases of one data set, not two regions. NO POSTING URL IS IN THE FEED; the posting page is https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/job/{id} (measured for westwing: HTTP 200, canonical https://westwing.jobs.personio.de/job/2814781?language=en; the personio tenant's own position 1834171 answered 404 on the same pattern). robots.txt of personio.jobs.personio.de: "User-agent: * / Allow: /". The docs state no rate limit or terms of use. A language the feed does not carry is NOT an error: language=xx answered the same 45,529 bytes as language=de, and the document without a language parameter equals language=en.
